description: Defines the LDAPAuthProvider class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for LDAP authentication providers within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin, encapsulating user distinguished name and user ID.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: A DTO class representing LDAP authentication provider details, specifically storing user distinguished name (userDN) and user ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the LDAPAuthProvider with userDN and userId.

methods.name: getUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the LDAP user.
